rubrics.name: User identity lookup before operations
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If the agent calls any tool other than find_user_id_by_name_zip or find_user_id_by_email before identifying the user, deduct 5. If the agent never calls find_user_id_by_name_zip or find_user_id_by_email, deduct 10. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: Correct tool for order modification
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If the agent calls cancel_pending_order on a delivered order, deduct 5. If the agent calls return_delivered_order_items on a pending order, deduct 5. If the agent calls modify_pending_order_items on a delivered order, deduct 5. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: Gather user details before address changes
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If the agent calls modify_pending_order_address or modify_user_address without first calling get_user_details, deduct 5. If the agent calls modify_pending_order_address or modify_user_address without first calling find_user_id_by_name_zip or find_user_id_by_email, deduct 3. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: Query order details before modifying
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If the agent calls modify_pending_order_items, modify_pending_order_address, or modify_pending_order_payment without first calling get_order_details for that order, deduct 5. If the agent calls cancel_pending_order without first calling get_order_details, deduct 3. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: Query product details before exchange
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If the agent calls exchange_delivered_order_items without first calling get_product_details or get_item_details for the replacement item, deduct 5. If the agent calls exchange_delivered_order_items without first calling get_order_details, deduct 3. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: No redundant duplicate tool calls
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. For each pair of consecutive calls to the same tool with identical arguments (excluding think), deduct 3. If the same tool+args appears 3 or more times, deduct 5. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: Minimal tool calls per task
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If the agent makes more than 10 tool calls total (excluding think), deduct 5. If the agent makes more than 15 tool calls total (excluding think), deduct 8. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: Retry on tool error with corrected args
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If a tool returns an error and the agent calls the same tool with identical arguments again, deduct 5. If a tool returns an error and the agent calls transfer_to_human_agents immediately, deduct 3. If a tool returns an error and the agent never retries with corrected arguments, deduct 5. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: No premature transfer to human
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If the agent calls transfer_to_human_agents before making at least 3 tool calls (excluding think), deduct 5. If the agent calls transfer_to_human_agents after a single tool error without retrying, deduct 3. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: Verify modifications after applying
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If the agent calls modify_pending_order_items, modify_pending_order_address, modify_pending_order_payment, cancel_pending_order, or exchange_delivered_order_items and does not call get_order_details on the same order afterward, deduct 5. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: Address all user requests
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If the user makes multiple requests in their first message and the agent addresses fewer than all of them before the final response, deduct 3 per unaddressed request. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: Include order IDs in responses
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If the agent's final response to the user does not contain any order ID (pattern O[0-9]{3} or #[A-Z0-9]+), deduct 5. If the agent discusses an order but does not include its ID in the same message, deduct 3 per missing ID. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: Include specific product details
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If the agent mentions a product but does not include its name or item number in the same message, deduct 3 per missing detail. If the agent's final response contains no product names or item numbers, deduct 5. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: Report price or refund amounts
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If the user asks about price, refund, or payment and the agent's response does not include a dollar amount ($[0-9]+), deduct 5. If the agent processes a return or exchange but does not tell the user the amount, deduct 3. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: Correct payment method identification
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If the agent calls modify_pending_order_payment or processes a refund without first calling get_user_details to check payment methods, deduct 5. If the agent suggests a payment method not in the user's profile, deduct 5. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: Use think tool for reasoning
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If the agent makes 3 or more consecutive tool calls without any think call in between, deduct 3. If the agent never calls think, deduct 2. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: No unnecessary get_item_details calls
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If the agent calls get_item_details for an item already retrieved via get_order_details or get_product_details, deduct 2 per redundant call. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: Confirm changes with user
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If the agent applies a modification (modify_pending_order_*, cancel_pending_order, exchange_delivered_order_items, return_delivered_order_items) without asking the user to confirm first, deduct 3. If the user explicitly asks for confirmation and the agent does not provide it, deduct 5. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: Report gift card balance when relevant
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If the user mentions gift card payment and the agent does not check or report the gift card balance (from get_user_details), deduct 5. If the agent reports an incorrect gift card balance, deduct 5. Clamp final score to [0,10].

rubrics.name: Correct order lookup by user identity
rubrics.rule: Start at 10. If the agent calls get_order_details without first identifying the user via find_user_id_by_name_zip or find_user_id_by_email, deduct 5. If the agent calls get_order_details with an order ID not belonging to the identified user, deduct 5. Clamp final score to [0,10].
